categories.main_business_segments: AVIC Xi'an Aircraft Industry Group primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sales, maintenance, and services of military large and medium-sized aircraft, civil aviation components, and aviation services. Its key products include military transport aircraft, bombers, special aircraft, and major components for domestic civil aircraft such as C919, ARJ21, AG600, and Xinzhou series. The company also provides aviation engineering technical support, user training, material support, and aircraft maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced digital design and manufacturing technologies, including digital assembly integration, precision parts manufacturing, large wing manufacturing, CNC shot peening, and large composite material component fabrication. It emphasizes integrated design, manufacturing, and service innovation, with a strong focus on intelligent manufacturing, automation, and digitalization. The firm also pursues foundational and frontier technology research, holding numerous national patents and provincial-level laboratories.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic military and civil aviation sectors, international aircraft manufacturers such as Boeing and Airbus, and major Chinese commercial aircraft companies like COMAC and AVIC General Aviation. The company serves strategic military clients and civil aviation markets, providing components for mainstream international aircraft models and domestic large and regional aircraft. It also participates in international subcontracting projects and aviation emergency rescue equipment markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with major production bases in Shaanxi Province (Xi'an and Hanzhong), Tianjin, and Gansu Province (Tianshui). It has significant international cooperation projects with customers in the United States and Europe, including Boeing and Airbus. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for over 96% of revenue, with growing international sales and subcontracting activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: AVIC Xi'an Aircraft Industry Group operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace supply chain, focusing on aircraft assembly, component manufacturing, and maintenance services. It acts as a major system integrator and key supplier of structural components for large aircraft, bridging upstream raw materials and downstream aircraft manufacturers and operators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological self-reliance and innovation, advancing digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities. It focuses on breakthroughs in key technologies for military and civil aircraft, expanding international subcontracting, and enhancing aviation service platforms. Strategic initiatives include smart party building, smart management, smart operations, and intelligent manufacturing, alongside deepening reforms and talent development to strengthen core competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aircraft and aviation components, supplemented by aviation maintenance, modification services, and technical support. The company also earns income from subcontracting production for international aircraft manufacturers and investment income from equity holdings. Sales are mostly direct, with a small portion through distributors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading Chinese aerospace manufacturer with a strong position in military transport and bomber aircraft, as well as a major supplier of structural components for domestic and international civil aircraft. It competes with other Chinese aerospace firms and international suppliers in the global aviation supply chain. Its strategic partnerships with Boeing, Airbus, and COMAC enhance its competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 40.3 billion, a 7.01% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 861 million, up 64.41%. Total assets were about RMB 80.9 billion, with a slight decrease from the previous year, while net assets increased by 21.14% to RMB 19.5 billion. The company maintains a steady growth trajectory with improving profitability and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: AVIC Xi'an Aircraft Industry Group offers integrated design and manufacturing capabilities for large and medium-sized military and civil aircraft, emphasizing advanced digital and intelligent manufacturing technologies. Its unique value lies in its comprehensive product portfolio, including critical structural components for major domestic and international aircraft programs, and its robust aviation service system. The company’s strong innovation culture, strategic international partnerships, and commitment to quality and timely delivery differentiate it in the aerospace industry.
